findings.title_en: Remaining carbohydrate budget appears complete after unquantified intake
findings.title_ru: Остаток углеводов выглядит известным при неполном дневнике
steps: Create a synthetic consented screened member with carb_max_g=40.
Confirm a diary.add for today with intake_status=unquantified and no recipe/grams.
Generate synthetic valid kitchen candidates and read first card budget.
findings.expected: Unknown intake must qualify the remaining budget as incomplete or unknown, rather than a known allowance for the whole day.
findings.impact: User or intent context can interpret an apparently full remaining allowance after eating an unweighed meal. This is a completeness/presentation bug, not proof of clinical harm.
findings.recommendation: Track all today entries when calculating completeness; return unknown/qualified remaining values when any intake is unquantified/estimated/unresolvable; keep known subtotal separate. Add mixed-known/unknown diary regression.
findings.limitations: No real intake or clinical outcome; budget is a product heuristic.
findings.status: baseline_reproduced; concurrent parent changes not independently reviewed

findings.title_en: Local-keyword classification skips Worker paid admission before kitchen design
findings.title_ru: Ключевое слово локального расчёта обходит платную квоту Worker перед генерацией кухни
steps: Use message: Рассчитай ужин: есть яйца, кабачок и шампиньоны; без покупок за 20 минут.
Evaluate the baseline Worker localEstimate predicate verbatim.
Call actual Service.chat with consent and a fake offline designer that records attempts.
findings.expected: Every request able to reach a provider must reserve member/global paid admission before dispatch.
findings.impact: Mixed kitchen/calculation wording can bypass Worker 30/member and 500/global admission; service-side default 60-call limit still exists. This does not establish unlimited access or a provider invoice.
findings.recommendation: Reserve conservative chat admission before bridge; refund only when trusted response confirms no model call, or use a server-owned deterministic operation classification. Add actual Worker-at-cap mixed-message regression.
findings.limitations: No full Worker/database at-cap E2E and no real provider call.
findings.status: baseline_reproduced; concurrent parent changes not independently reviewed

findings.title_en: Saved shopping subtracts batch stock from per-person plan needs
findings.title_ru: Покупки сохранённого плана вычитают кладовую всего блюда из потребности одной порции
steps: Build actual validated two-serving omelette draft using egg 200g and zucchini 240g.
Read actual card missing list: egg 100g + zucchini 120g.
Use the same portions=1 meal representation saved by kitchen_day and its batch pantry snapshot; call actual kitchen_shopping.
findings.expected: Retain batch-servings semantics for shopping/export separately from per-person nutrient plan; do not lose the previously disclosed shortage.
findings.impact: Shopping after save and PDF shopping can omit ingredients for additional eaters or show inconsistent amounts relative to the Studio batch.
findings.recommendation: Store and apply accepted plan serving count when constructing shopping; keep nutrition per person. Add a fully accepted multi-serving day/export regression.
findings.limitations: Not a complete accepted-day E2E; plan representation intentionally constructed synthetically.
findings.status: baseline_reproduced; concurrent parent changes not independently reviewed

findings.title_en: Profile editor drops saved allergens absent from its checkbox list
findings.title_ru: Анкета удаляет сохранённые аллергены, которых нет в её checkbox-списке
steps: Save a supported mustard allergy through actual service proposal/apply.
Derive visible checkbox IDs from baseline app.js ALLERGENS.
Project saved allergies into those checkboxes as fillOnboard does.
Submit checked IDs plus an unrelated display-name edit through actual proposal/apply.
findings.expected: An unrelated form edit preserves all saved canonical allergens; every supported allergen must be editable or retained until explicit removal.
findings.impact: Existing mustard/mollusc/gluten/lupin/sulfite restrictions can disappear from a confirmed profile round trip, allowing later recipes containing the lost allergen. No actual exposure or clinical harm was tested.
findings.recommendation: Render all canonical allergens and preserve unknown/unrepresented saved values until explicitly reviewed/removed; show removals clearly in confirmation. Add round-trip tests over all 16 values and unrelated edits.
findings.limitations: No rendered DOM/browser; user still confirms the generated profile proposal.
findings.status: baseline_reproduced; concurrent parent changes not independently reviewed

limitations: Four baseline synthetic observations only; no repeated audit of concurrent parent fixes.
No full suites/build, CI dispatch, live cloud/runtime, real user/device/browser or clinical validation.
Source-derived UI projection is not rendered DOM evidence; quota and batch probes have explicit component-level boundaries.
Reported GitHub hosted startup failure exact cause unknown; prior Codex GitHub review usage limit is separate.
Source registry references were inspected locally; no new paper retrieval or independent clinical evidence appraisal.
